lifecycle.retention: Retain editable logical subject and pinned provenance; product implementation/acceptance are separate records.

body.value:
Проверять публичный запуск формы со связанным meta, вкладки, Save/Back Save,
pin черновика и отсутствие SQLite-записи при нарушении условий.
FormAppearanceTest проверяет обе темы, перенос выбранного имени и нижний Save.
V2 visibility: hide/show/rotation/durable recovery не стирают текст; hidden static
required не блокирует Save, а видимый required остаётся обязательным.

review.value: Public form/meta/Save/pin/no-write tests and hidden-value retention with visible required semantics remain complete.

authority_limit.value: Path applicability is reviewed separately from the rule's textual triggers. Every source condition and heading remains attached; no automatic predicate or lifecycle inference. Stored commands and dates do not grant current execution, freshness or product acceptance. Existing instruction clients/checkers remain effective until measured cutover.
